params.name: q
params.description: The search query, using the Lucene-like syntax. Example: name:charizard (subtypes:mega OR subtypes:vmax)

params.name: page
params.description: The page of data to access.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of results to return (max 250).

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The field(s) to order the results by, comma delimited. Prefix a field with a hyphen for descending order, for example orderBy=name,-number or orderBy=-set.releaseDate.

params.name: select
params.description: A comma delimited list of fields to return in the response, for example select=id,name,rarity. All fields are returned by default.

items.docs: Search for one or many cards given a Lucene-like search query. Every field in the card object is searchable, including nested fields via dot notation (set.id, attacks.name, legalities.standard). Supports keyword and phrase matching, AND/OR/NOT logic, wildcards (name:char*), exact matching (!name:charizard), and range searches (hp:[150 TO *], nationalPokedexNumbers:[1 TO 151]).

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the card, for example xy1-1 or base1-4.

items.docs: Fetch the details of a single card by its ID (for example xy1-1).
